findings.description: Muted text colour (--muted #c3c8cd) on white gives about 1.7:1 contrast, far below WCAG AA 4.5:1. It is used for the table headers (Title, Category, Amount, Actions), the Category column values and the 'Signed in as' line, so these are hard or impossible to read, especially for low-vision users and in bright light.
repro: Observe the table header labels, the category column values and the 'Signed in as' line in light grey.

findings.description: Long expense titles are not wrapped (td:first-child is white-space: nowrap). On desktop the title runs over the Category, Amount and Actions cells, overlapping the amount and the Edit/Delete buttons. On a 360 px phone the title pushes the page to about 1078 px wide, so the whole page scrolls horizontally.
repro: Sign in as editor-029d and open /expenses/new.

Add an expense with a title of about 120 characters (for example 'Conference travel reimbursement for the regional partner summit including taxis and parking' followed by many x characters), category travel, amount 98765.43.
At 1280 px, view /expenses: the title overlaps the category, amount and Edit/Delete controls.
At 360 px, sign in as viewer-2512 and view /expenses: document scroll width is about 1078 px, so the page scrolls sideways.

notes: Tested at 1280 px (editor and viewer) and 360/414 px phone emulation with touch. Checked: totals against row sums (correct for full list and for category filters travel, meals and office), viewer access to /expenses/new, /expenses/1/edit and POST delete (all 403), server-side validation on POST /expenses (400 for blank title, bad category, negative, non-numeric, 3-decimal and whitespace title), the failed-login message and the add/edit flash messages. No other defects found. Not tested: full keyboard-only tab sequence and focus-ring contrast (the amber focus outline is about 2.5:1 on white, judged a design choice and not reported). Data note: during testing I added the expenses 'QA Probe Edited' (edited to 10.00), 'X' (0.00) and the long-title expense to the shared dataset. The amount with no thousands separator ($1234.50) was seen but not reported as it looks like a style choice.

cost.notes: estimate from 41141 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0004-$0.0049
